ModMetaData.name: Gender Balance
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Choose how often new people are men or women.
- Quick choice with one click: Like the game, More women, More men, or Custom. - Shows how many men and women your colony has right now. - Joining your colony (wanderers, starting colonists, anyone made for your faction): slider 0–100 % men. - Everyone else (visitors, traders, raiders, refugees, slaves for sale): optional second slider. - Humanoid Alien Races: a slider for every alien race that overrides the race's own chance (default = the race's own value, reset button per race). - Optional, per race: block body types for men or women (e.g. no Fat or Hulk women) and set traits new people always or never have.
- Recommended-style settings window shared with my other mods.
Never changes a gender that a quest, a relative, a pawn kind or a race asks for, and never touches one-gender races (including Humanoid Alien Races set to one gender). Works for new people only – existing pawns stay as they are. Safe to add or remove at any time.
Options → Mod settings → Gender Balance.
